raw_text: Wreck reported near 41-30.71N 098-47.85W, hull just awash, no marks. Keep well clear.

Observed a derelict fiberglass sailboat adrift in the main shipping lane at 19-56.22S 008-52.03E, no lights, mast down, half-submerged with debris alongside. Traffic was heavy and it was hard to pick up on radar; recommend caution and broadcast to nearby traffic, as it’s a serious collision risk.
Possible rocket debris/flare seen at 43-04.66N 095-55.57W drifting, keep clear.

Outbound in the shipping lane near 22-24.18N 084-35.30W, observed an unlit target drifting slowly across the track, no AIS and no response on VHF. Altered course to pass clear; target appears low in the water, possibly small craft or buoy, recommend caution for following traffic in reduced visibility tonight.
Unlit debris reported near 40-06.23N 093-46.36W. Saw it drifting, keep clear.

Passing through the shipping lane off 27-18.29N 067-11.39W at 0415Z, we came up on an unlit object just under the surface, possibly a drifting container or half-sunken log, no AIS or radar return until 0.3 NM. Recommend sharp lookout and reduced speed; object was moving slowly with the current toward the southbound track.
Generic hazard reported near 35-58.77N 092-40.83W. Passing traffic should keep clear.

Spotted a derelict 25‑30 ft fiberglass sailboat adrift in the shipping lane at 05-03.36N 052-00.01W, mast down and hull low in the water. No AIS or lights visible, drifting east with light current. Recommend caution and broadcast to nearby traffic.
Derelict hull low in water sighted near 38-03.55N 096-53.12W, barely making way. No lights, drift unknown.

Spotted active rocket launch/booster falling in shipping lane at 36-47.04N 075-58.85W around 0415Z; loud boom, bright trail, and debris splash within 0.5 nm of track. Recommend wide berth and monitor VHF for range safety warnings, as tugs nearby were altering course. Smoke cloud drifting east and pieces floating for at least 2 miles.
Derelict half-submerged, no lights, drifting near 44-19.02N 098-42.57W. Looks like old skiff, low in water.

Sighted a derelict 6–7m wooden fishing skiff adrift in the main shipping lane at 27-57.18N 035-17.70W, low in the water with no lights or marks. Looked unmanned, slight list to port, could be a collision hazard for deep-draft traffic in reduced visibility. We passed close aboard and could see no name or registration.
Rocket debris drifting at 42-13.38N 092-20.92W, low in water, no lights. Gave it wide berth.
Noted a generic hazard in main shipping lane near 36-44.29N 075-57.01W, unlit and hard to identify; advise extra lookout and reduced speed until clear.
Derelict craft adrift near 35-46.89N 098-55.03W, low in water. No lights seen.
Spotted a derelict sailboat low in the water at 16-20.65N 061-37.57W in the northbound lane; no lights or AIS seen, drifting slowly east. Use caution passing tonight please.
Floating debris reported near 34-11.43N 098-40.07W, low in water. Keep sharp lookout.

Spotted an unlit wreck or large steel obstruction just below surface in the outbound shipping lane near 21-06.67N 067-21.83W around 0215 UTC; only a rusted pipe and a small slick showing, no AIS. Tide was ebbing, we felt a slight bump at 8 kts and altered to starboard; traffic heavy with container ships, echo sounder showed something 1–2 m below surface, recommend caution and mark as hazard.
Rocket activity reported near 43-21.95N 092-57.73W, flames/smoke on horizon, loud detonation. Recommend keep clear.

Spotted a derelict timber hull, partly awash and drifting slow across the southbound lane near 64-13.25N 060-05.51W. No lights, no AIS, just a low dark shape with a broken mast sticking out. Could be hard to see in chop, recommend passing well clear and alerting traffic control.
Possible hazard sighted near 38-24.97N 098-49.37W, hard to make out on radar. Steer clear until verified.
Observed small rocket debris drifting in shipping lane near 11-19.87N 059-38.55W; looks intact and partly submerged, could foul propellers, suggest caution.
Old wreck awash near 42-29.92N 092-57.73W, hard to see in chop.

Noticed a derelict fishing skiff adrift in the traffic lane at 40-15.29N 063-49.31W, low in the water and drifting north with the current, no AIS or lights seen on the hull. We altered course to clear it; recommend caution for deep-draft vessels transiting this lane, especially at night or in reduced visibility.
Wreck just awash at 41-47.33N 093-23.43W, no marker seen. Keep clear.

At 29-28.40N 083-19.30W in the southbound shipping lane we sighted an unlit object low in the water, possibly a drifting container or small craft, hard to pick up on radar. Passed it close to the separation zone, recommend caution, extra lookout after dark, and reduced speed if needed.
Derelict hull, low in water, barely awash near 34-19.99N 096-01.31W. No lights or marks.

Observed uncharted floating debris field in main shipping lane near 18-01.71N 071-44.35W at 0415 UTC. Multiple logs and plastic drums drifting SW, difficult to spot in low light; recommend reduced speed and extra lookout until cleared by local traffic or authorities in area.
Generic hazard reported near 44-31.40N 099-10.47W. Unclear object drifting, keep sharp lookout.

Observed unlit wreckage in main shipping lane at 19-30.53N 046-29.41W during night transit; looks like low-profile hull just awash and hard to see, no marks or AIS. Recommend caution and reduced speed until marked.
Rocket activity observed near 41-54.92N 098-28.94W, bright flare and debris falling. Giving wide berth.

Spotted a derelict fishing skiff adrift in the eastbound shipping lane near 25-34.44N 074-52.52W, no lights or AIS, low in the water with one gunwale awash. Blue hull, about 6 m, engine cowl missing, no crew visible; last seen 1030 UTC. Wind NW 15, seas slight, drifting about 1 kt to SE, recommend caution and traffic warnings, especially for fast ferries and tugs.
Derelict vessel, low in water, adrift near 35-57.27N 097-29.23W.

Observed rocket launch activity near 07-10.96N 057-49.83W in a busy shipping lane this evening, with glowing exhaust and debris falling on the track. We altered course and speed to keep clear; recommend caution for westbound traffic in the next hour.
Possible hazard near 37-23.74N 093-16.44W, not sure what—something low in water. Kept clear, suggest caution.

Noted unlit wreckage at 40-41.43N 072-02.99W in the main shipping lane, looks like a partially submerged hull with debris awash. Passed within 0.3 nm; keep clear, no AIS target seen and no visible markers.
At 35-14.03N 093-08.85W saw something off, unlit and hard to make out. Keep sharp lookout, could be debris.

Noted an unlit wreck protruding just awash in the main shipping lane at 10-16.83N 061-54.46W, about 2 cable off the port-hand edge of the traffic line; no buoyage or AIS target seen. Passed at slow ahead and saw breaking seas over it on the flood. Suggest caution and report to VTS.
Debris field sighted near 41-35.43N 099-51.18W, drifting. Caution advised.

Spotted a derelict skiff low in the water in the shipping lane off 16-44.29N 084-38.86W, no lights or markings, drifting slowly across the track. Looked to be about 7–8 m, partially flooded, with debris alongside. Recommend vessels keep sharp lookout and report.
Noted hazard near 40-04.36N 095-47.20W — something adrift, unclear, low in water. Proceeded slow.

Noted a wreck at 29-18.75N 087-07.23W lying just inside the northbound lane, low water showing only a few timbers and some oil sheen. Vessels are passing close; recommend giving a wide berth and marking on charts until further notice.
Unclear hazard reported near 41-02.17N 095-56.74W. Keep a sharp watch.
Spotted a derelict wooden fishing skiff adrift in the traffic lane near 25-37.35N 080-23.67W at dawn, low in water, no lights, drifting northeast creating risk for passing traffic.
Rough shoal or obstruction reported near 33-40.34N 093-52.03W, no marks, keep clear.
Observed rocket launch in shipping lane at 25-38.11N 080-27.71W; bright plume and falling debris near track, recommend wide berth until clear.
Derelict hull awash, no lights, near 39-33.30N 099-40.52W. Drifting slow to NE, keep sharp lookout.

Spotted a derelict fishing skiff adrift in the shipping lane near 33-29.07N 079-13.07W this morning, low in the water with no lights or AIS, likely abandoned. It was drifting across the traffic separation scheme on a northeasterly set, posing a collision risk to passing traffic. Kept clear and broadcast a security call on VHF.
Unknown floating hazard spotted near 38-20.07N 096-25.84W, keep sharp lookout.

At 26-57.48N 026-33.21W in the main shipping lane, observed a large unlit object adrift, possibly a container or debris, low in the water and hard to see on radar; seen at dusk with swell, passing traffic should slow and keep sharp lookout.
Wreck showing just under surface at 38-24.80N 094-16.39W. Unmarked, small debris around, watch close.

Passing through the shipping lane off the cape at 25-37.52N 080-23.88W, we observed this afternoon a small rocket flare launching from the water, arcing low across our track. No debris seen, but recommend caution and keeping clear in case of additional launches.
Wreck reported near 43-03.91N 099-48.68W, low water. Unlit, barely awash.
Observed unlit rocket body floating low in shipping lane at 29-50.82N 089-55.10W, possible space debris; keep clear and advise traffic until recovery reported.
Wreck reported near 40-33.35N 099-44.44W, looks like a low-lying hull just awash. Give it a wide berth.

Observed uncharted wreck lying in shipping lane at 19-58.72S 008-49.05E, during outbound transit at slack water. Buoyage absent; only intermittent dark shape and turbulence on radar/echo sounder, depth shoaled from 18m to 9m over it, recommend caution and note to hydrography. Passed starboard at 0.3nm, heavy traffic, suggest temporary warning and avoid nighttime passage until marked properly.
Observed rocket activity near 41-41.82N 099-22.17W. Debris splashdown possible; give wide berth.
Noted unlit drifting container in shipping lane near 13-23.76N 068-03.86W; passed close on starboard. Recommend caution for inbound traffic.
At 36-30.14N 092-19.72W saw some hazard in the water, not sure what it was, gave it wide berth. Please be cautious in area.
Spotted an unlit object drifting in the shipping lane near 11-19.76N 060-10.33W around 0200 UTC, likely debris or small craft. Recommend caution and reduced speed until cleared.
Wreck awash just off channel, debris around. Position 33-40.79N 097-07.25W.

Spotted derelict fishing skiff adrift in main inbound shipping lane at 08-05.12N 057-01.10W around 0430 UTC, no AIS or lights, low in the water and drifting NE with the tide. We altered course to starboard and advised VTS; looks about 6-7m long, partially submerged, could be hard to see in the swell. Recommend caution for deep-draft traffic in this busy approach area until it’s marked or removed.
Unlit obstruction just off track near 40-47.24N 092-54.97W. Steer clear, unsure what it is.
Spotted derelict steel trawler adrift in shipping lane at 21-57.29N 089-51.62W, low in water with no lights or crew. Passed within 0.3nm; appears abandoned, rolling in swell, hazard today.
Wreck reported at 34-42.12N 092-25.11W. Shallow, unlit, debris around.

Spotted a derelict fishing skiff, half-submerged, no lights or markings, in moderate swell, drifting across the northbound lane at 28-38.67N 079-46.29W. Heavy traffic; recommend caution and reporting immediately.
Derelict hull drifting near 41-22.40N 099-31.22W, low in water, no lights. Passed close.
Observed partially submerged wreck in main shipping lane near 60-01.03N 077-21.16W; unlit, only hull visible at low tide. Recommend caution and wide berth; appears new, debris scattered nearby.
Rocket launch debris falling near 42-06.92N 092-44.59W, loud blast and smoke. Keeping clear.
Spotted derelict fishing boat adrift in main shipping lane at 50-51.18N 058-00.46W, low in water, no lights or AIS, drifting east around 2 knots slowly.
Wreck sighted at 44-48.01N 093-12.72W, just awash. Unlit, no marker.
Sighted derelict wooden fishing boat awash with no lights in shipping lane near 36-43.57N 075-58.07W around 2130 UTC. Drifting slowly to the NE, no crew seen; keep clear.
Rocket activity observed near 35-24.59N 095-50.68W, loud launch and debris falling. Avoid area.
Spotted a derelict fishing skiff adrift near 20-10.52N 087-26.24W in the shipping lane, low in the water and unlit. Please advise traffic.
Generic hazard noted near 33-22.60N 095-03.09W. Keep clear, unsure of type.

Northbound in the main traffic lane near 29-19.52N 038-21.46W we encountered a cluster of unlit small craft drifting across the lane, no AIS and only one showing a weak flashlight. Had to alter 15 degrees to port and slow to 8 knots; recommend extra lookout and passing with caution until daylight. Sea state slight but visibility hazy with scattered rain, making them hard to pick up on radar.
Rocket debris sighted near 37-16.48N 095-07.64W drifting, possible unexploded. Keep clear.

Passed a drifting rocket motor casing in the traffic lane westbound at 29-29.76N 083-16.25W; about 3 m long, blackened with scorch marks, bobbing half-submerged and making a clear radar return. No lights or markings, slight fuel sheen, poses collision risk to ships in the lane; recommend wide berth and notify traffic. Sea state 3, drifting north with current, could be from recent launch debris observed last night.
Derelict sailboat low in water at 36-23.27N 094-30.55W, drifting. Unlit.

Spotted a derelict wooden fishing boat, no lights or markings, low in the water and partially awash in the main shipping lane in moderate traffic at 33-22.69N 079-24.76W around 0230 UTC this morning. No crew seen, drifting slowly to the NE with 1-2m swell, VHF calls unanswered, hull dark, looks like a night hazard; reported to nearby vessels and suggest a wide berth.
Wreck sighted near 37-14.22N 096-11.19W. Low in water, unlit.

Observed unlit wreck structure in the shipping lane at 25-32.69N 074-46.32W; low profile just awash at half tide, no AIS target. Passed 0.5 nm off; looks like small barge or fishing hull, potential snag for deep draft, current sets across, difficult to spot until close in clear weather.
Derelict craft adrift near 42-45.81N 096-33.20W, no lights, low in water. Drift SE with current.
Sighted a derelict fishing skiff adrift near 09-18.87N 079-56.38W in the main traffic lane, low in water and unlit at dusk, crew absent.
Wreck reported at 37-54.75N 097-42.73W. Low in water, barely showing.

Passed through the outbound shipping lane near 63-43.67N 068-27.79W and noticed an unlit wooden skiff drifting across the traffic separation at slow speed, no AIS or lights. It’s low in the water and hard to spot in chop; recommend extra lookout and reduce speed if transiting at night.
Seen hazard at 44-27.96N 096-48.83W, keep sharp lookout. Unclear object drifting, no lights.
Observed a large drifting log with attached net in the inbound shipping lane near 06-09.76N 055-08.82W; no AIS target nearby, creating collision risk for vessels at dusk in poor visibility.
Wreck reported at 36-33.89N 094-14.20W. Low profile, just bits showing, keep clear.
In the traffic lane near 28-26.70N 087-56.67W sighted unlit debris adrift, possibly pallets, posing a hazard to northbound traffic; advise extra caution here.
Derelict hull adrift near 38-28.83N 096-28.47W. Low in water, hard to see.

Observed rocket launch trajectory crossing shipping lane near 36-44.60N 076-00.64W at 0210Z, bright plume and debris risk. Recommend wide berth and monitor VHF; possible falling objects in area for next 30 minutes tonight.
Wreck reported near 39-51.06N 095-49.69W, low in water, no light. Give it wide berth.
Outbound in the shipping lane near 29-56.75N 089-56.05W, we sighted an unlit small craft drifting across the traffic separation zone, no AIS. Appeared to be disabled, persons waving on our beam.
Wreck sighted near 44-37.59N 099-54.03W just awash. No marks, could snag.

Observed an unlit drifting object in main shipping lane near 14-13.93N 061-03.15W at dusk, likely a small log or debris, low freeboard and hard to spot in moderate swell. Recommend caution and extra lookout until cleared.
Derelict wooden skiff, low in water, adrift near 44-34.56N 094-46.90W. No lights, no markings.

Noted unlit floating debris (likely timber) in westbound shipping lane near 28-31.24N 080-35.73W at 0200Z, causing evasive action by traffic; recommend immediate caution and broadcast to nearby vessels.
Wreck reported near 44-51.81N 092-33.72W, low water. Marking unclear.
Spotted a small rocket/flare drifting in shipping lane near 21-58.12N 089-48.75W, still smoking and bobbing; advised nearby traffic to keep clear, possible misfire from shore at midday today.
Rocket/flare fired near 43-22.33N 099-05.32W off our bow, drifting down, no contact. Possible distress nearby.

At 25-41.64N 074-55.92W in the northbound lane we observed a rocket stage or booster drifting low in the water, with debris and fuel sheen around it, unlit and a navigation risk. Keep clear and advise VTS; drifting with tide and current here.
Wreck reported near 36-17.99N 093-01.59W, low in water. No marks seen, keep clear.
Spotted derelict wooden boat adrift in shipping lane near 29-13.76N 087-42.09W. No lights, low in water, hard to see on radar; vessels should keep sharp lookout tonight in moderate seas.
Wreck showing just awash at 42-52.95N 096-36.72W near channel edge, no marker seen. Keep well clear.

Observed a small rocket launch from a fishing skiff right in the eastbound lane near 25-37.70N 080-23.21W; flare and smoke arced low across traffic, causing us to slow and sound warning. Other vessels should keep clear and report to VTS until activity ceases. Looks deliberate, not distress, but unpredictable and close to ships.
Derelict hull drifting, low in water near 44-13.99N 092-24.86W. Hard to spot in chop.

At 23-24.27N 097-30.34W in the main shipping lane we sighted an unlit rocket/floating missile-shaped object half-submerged, about 3–4 m long, metallic with fins, drifting slowly west with the current; no AIS or guard craft nearby. It was a close-quarters hazard for passing traffic and could be struck in low visibility, recommend wide berth until authorities inspect.
Wreck sighted near 39-53.07N 098-35.99W, low in water. No marks seen.

While transiting main shipping lane near 06-46.63N 056-43.57W, observed a rocket splashdown and debris field drifting across the lane, likely from recent launch; fragments and fuel sheen on surface, intermittent smoke. We reduced speed and altered course to avoid floating pieces; advise caution, possible secondary splashdown, and report to traffic control in area immediately.
Rocket sighted at 43-05.59N 094-37.24W, low altitude, moving fast. Unclear origin, keep clear.
Sighted derelict cabin cruiser, awash and drifting in shipping lane at 25-33.68N 074-45.90W; no lights or AIS, potential hazard to passing traffic.
Derelict boat low in water adrift near 37-22.60N 098-18.05W. No lights.
Passing through main lane near 07-50.03N 057-28.64W, noticed unlit drifting object, possibly container or timber, moving with current; could be hazard to traffic.
Derelict hull low in water near 42-53.82N 094-35.51W. No lights, hard to see.
In shipping lane near 25-05.12N 097-08.26W, sighted unlit drifting object, possibly container or timber, half-submerged. Poses risk to traffic; keep sharp lookout this evening here.
Debris hazard reported near 33-45.02N 096-23.18W, floating lumber field. Steer clear.
Noted generic hazard in shipping lane at 05-24.26N 052-35.06W; keep sharp lookout and reduce speed until clear, seems unmarked.
Generic hazard observed near 34-56.08N 098-01.60W. Poor visibility, proceed with caution.
Noticed unlit object drifting in main traffic lane near 26-36.50N 090-31.09W around 2200Z, looked like a container or pallet. Kept clear and advised nearby traffic on VHF.
Wreck reported at 34-57.03N 095-41.63W, low in water, little visible. Keep clear.

Passing the lane off 46-29.85N 059-43.85W at 0810 UTC, we sighted a wreck awash just to starboard of the track, with rusted plating and a small mast showing, no buoys or lights. Traffic heavy and it sits right in the separation scheme, suggest caution and mark; depth unknown, breakers visible on the swell at low tide today.
Derelict skiff low in water at 38-11.67N 095-26.96W, no lights. Almost awash, drifted toward channel.
Spotted wreck remains just awash in traffic lane at 10-37.23N 071-36.35W; radar clutter and breaking seas, keep clear, reported by fishing boat nearby.
Hazard reported near 43-34.80N 099-58.51W. Unclear object in water, keep sharp lookout.

Reported a derelict skiff adrift in the shipping lane near 20-01.96N 091-02.81W; low in the water with no lights or markings. Passed it on our starboard side around 0.3 NM, looked abandoned and a collision risk for traffic.
Derelict hull low in water at 38-55.51N 098-40.84W, no lights seen. Drifting slowly.
Spotted a derelict small fishing skiff adrift in the shipping lane near 06-09.53N 055-17.12W. No lights or markings, low freeboard; poses collision risk at night to passing traffic.
Rocket seen rising offshore near 43-28.71N 093-04.79W. Loud and low over traffic.

While transiting the main shipping lane off 10-42.69N 061-42.56W at 12 kts, we encountered a large unlit steel object adrift, possibly a container or pontoon, low in the water and hard to pick up on radar until close. We altered course to pass clear and recommend caution for vessels on this route. No AIS or lights seen, drifting NE with light swell today.
Derelict boat low in water at 37-42.59N 093-46.66W, no lights, drifting. Nearly missed it.

Noted partially submerged wreck in main shipping lane at 28-33.70N 080-24.89W, just awash at low tide with light debris. Recommend wide berth; no marker buoy visible. Seen by bridge watch at 0830, calm seas.
Derelict hull adrift near 40-12.82N 099-47.50W, low in water, no lights. Drift unknown.

Northbound in the traffic lane we observed a large rocket stage splashing down and venting at 13-24.14N 055-55.08W, with scattered debris and a strong fuel odor drifting across the lane; we altered course to avoid it. Debris field appeared about 0.5 nm wide, unlit, some pieces just awash, so keep a sharp lookout and give it a wide berth.
Possible hazard near 39-54.40N 098-29.29W. Marked in log, keep sharp lookout.
Noted unlit wreckage, likely small trawler, awash just below surface at 10-07.85N 076-19.74W in main shipping lane; no marks or AIS, keep clear and warn traffic on last night's passage.
Rocket launch activity observed near 44-45.33N 094-06.04W, bright ascent and falling debris/splash zone. Recommend wide berth.

Spotted a derelict fishing skiff adrift in the eastbound shipping lane near 21-02.96N 096-43.41W, unlit and low in the water, no AIS. Looks abandoned, some debris alongside, and she was drifting across traffic on a light southerly set. Recommend caution and a wide berth for anyone making the lane tonight; we altered 1 nm to pass.
Wreck seen at 33-09.85N 099-37.90W, low in water, no markers. Slow up in vicinity.

Passed a wreck hazard in the shipping lane at 10-05.70N 061-01.75W; low profile hull showing at low tide with debris around it. Radar return weak until close. Recommend giving it wide berth, especially in poor visibility or strong cross-current.
Rocket seen arcing up from shore near 41-52.19N 092-05.40W, loud detonation; keep clear.
Passed partially submerged wreck in shipping lane near 21-30.71N 086-41.46W; only mast and debris visible seen showing at low swell. Recommend caution and broadcast to traffic, no marks or lights.
Derelict boat adrift at 41-06.08N 099-19.08W; low in the water, no lights. Drift to east.

Saw an unmarked wreck awash in the shipping lane near 29-52.02N 089-56.47W; only a few rusted frames and oily sheen visible at low swell, no buoy or light. We passed close in moderate traffic and it’s right on the track of inbound feeders, recommend wide berth until charted and marked.
Rocket fell into sea near 40-12.44N 098-21.01W, splash and debris, steer clear.
Observed active rocket launch debris and smoke trail crossing shipping lane near 28-32.00N 080-22.19W; advised all traffic to keep clear 5 NM, falling fragments reported on watch tonight southbound.
Possible hazard reported near 42-27.60N 095-58.09W, details unclear. Proceed with caution.
Noticed a partially submerged wreck in the shipping lane near 12-24.74N 070-04.17W. Only a mast and oily sheen visible, no buoyage seen — give it wide berth tonight.
Wreck sighted near 44-23.95N 096-38.06W. Low profile, barely awash at low tide.

Observed a rocket launch/descending debris in shipping lane near 11-07.12N 060-47.25W at 2140Z; bright plume and falling pieces seen to the south. Maintained course but advised nearby traffic to keep clear as splashdown area uncertain, possible unburned fuel or debris on surface. No official notice received on VHF.
Strange unlit object drifting near 34-32.51N 096-29.84W, hard to see until close. Keep clear.
Wreck reported in shipping lane at 40-25.55N 063-51.47W, low water, barely awash at spring tide; keep clear, unlit and no AIS target noted.
Spotted rocket debris drifting near 42-51.90N 094-34.58W, sharp metal, keep clear.
Passed a partially submerged wreck in the outbound shipping lane at 63-46.08N 068-35.74W; only debris and a mast showing, no buoyage—keep clear.
Derelict hull adrift near 41-55.33N 095-49.46W, low freeboard, no lights. Drifted east with swell.

Transiting the eastbound lane near 12-32.72N 073-26.03W we passed a loose, partially submerged timber raft about 15 meters long, drifting across the traffic separation scheme with no lights or markings. Current and wind were pushing it toward the centerline, so recommend caution for deep‑draft vessels and night traffic. We altered course to starboard to pass clear; debris could snag propellers or damage hulls if struck at speed.
Derelict boat adrift near 40-46.31N 092-32.70W, low in water. No lights seen.

Spotted a partially submerged derelict fishing boat in the main lane near 11-55.27N 054-38.22W. No lights or markings, just low freeboard and drifting east with current—could be hard to see at night there.
Wreck just awash near 41-47.25N 095-38.22W. Unlit, looks like old steel hull.

Observed active rocket launch/flight path crossing shipping lane near 18-52.59N 092-12.05W at 1430Z; bright flare and debris trail overhead, no broadcast warning heard on VHF. We altered 2 nm south and noted smoke plume drifting east; AIS traffic heavy in area, recommend wide berth and watch for falling fragments for next 30 minutes.
Rocket fell in water near 42-07.94N 099-26.50W. Loud splash, debris floating, avoid area.
Wreck reported near 29-51.16N 089-55.31W in the traffic lane, looks like partially submerged hull with debris around it. Advise caution and keep a wide berth, poor visibility at dusk.
Unlit debris drifting near channel at 36-49.49N 093-34.07W. Passing close, keep sharp lookout.
Derelict skiff adrift in shipping lane near 10-05.12N 060-39.22W, low in the water with no lights or markings. Reported at dusk; posed close-quarters risk to northbound traffic.
Wreck just below surface near 38-07.34N 098-05.94W. Unlit, not marked.

Passed a semi-submerged wreck right in the traffic lane at 05-16.10N 052-40.52W; looks like a small workboat with bow up, stern just below surface, no marker buoys or lights. We altered course to starboard to avoid, but it's hard to spot in chop and could snag a deep-draft vessel; traffic heavy here and a clear hazard for night runs, recommend immediate broadcast warning.
Derelict vessel adrift near 36-10.31N 097-01.78W, no lights seen. Marked on radar.

Passed close to uncharted wreckage at 31-57.59N 064-39.81W in main outbound lane; only a small mast and debris awash at low tide, no buoying. Recommend caution for deep-draft traffic as it lies just west of the track and could foul nets. Strong current set us onto it before we corrected on VHF today.
